description: This file contains implementation functions related to handling 'tree' objects in a git repository, including reading trees, comparing names, parsing tree buffers, and looking up trees.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Data structure representing a git tree object, with buffer, size, and object metadata.

classes.name: name_entry
classes.description: Structure representing an entry within a git tree, including name, mode, and oid.

methods.name: int read_tree_at(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,int depth,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Recursively reads entries from a tree structure within a repository, applying a callback function to each entry.

methods.name: int read_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Initiates reading of a tree object from a repository, calling read_tree_at internally.

methods.name: int base_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Compares two entry names with consideration for directory modes.

methods.name: int df_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Like base_name_compare but treats directory and file entries as equal during comparison.

methods.name: int name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,const char * name2,size_t len2)
methods.description: Basic comparison of two entry names.

methods.name: struct:tree * lookup_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Retrieves a tree object from the repository given its object ID.

methods.name: int parse_tree_buffer(struct tree * item,void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Parses a buffer to initialize a tree object without reading from disk.

methods.name: int parse_tree_gently(struct tree * item,int quiet_on_missing)
methods.description: Reads and validates a tree object from storage, with error handling.

methods.name: void free_tree_buffer(struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: struct:tree * parse_tree_indirect(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Peels an object ID to a tree object.

ctags.name: base_name_compare
ctags.pattern: /^int base_name_compare(const char *name1, size_t len1, int mode1,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)

ctags.name: df_name_compare
ctags.pattern: /^int df_name_compare(const char *name1, size_t len1, int mode1,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)

ctags.name: name_compare
ctags.pattern: /^int name_compare(const char *name1, size_t len1, const char *name2, size_t len2)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * name1,size_t len1,const char * name2,size_t len2)

ctags.name: parse_tree_buffer
ctags.pattern: /^int parse_tree_buffer(struct tree *item, void *buffer, unsigned long size)$/

ctags.name: read_tree
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)

ctags.name: read_tree_at
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,int depth,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
